conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: Hello. My name is Randy Gutierrez, and I'm a baby. I'm here because I've been feeling sick for a couple of days now. I have a runny nose, a cough, and I've had a low-grade fever. I've also been pulling on my ears and rubbing my nose a lot. My older sister was sick, and I think I might have caught something from her.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please confirm your age, gender, and the exact duration of your symptoms? Also, have you had any recent vaccinations or exposure to sick individuals besides your sister?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm a baby, so I don't know my exact age, but I was born in 2020. My symptoms started around supper time last night, and I've been feeling sick since then. I've been exposed to my older sister who was sick, and also to my nephew who had a sinus infection. I don't know about any vaccinations.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide information about the patient's current temperature, any changes in appetite or sleep, and whether there has been any discharge from the nose or ears?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: My temperature was 100.3 when I checked it earlier. I had some appetite, ate a little bit this morning, but then didn't want much else. I've been rubbing my nose a lot and pulling on my ears, but I don't think there's any discharge from my ears. My nose has been runny with clear mucus.
